record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the two conditions from Conjecture 5.1, namely V(0) = C1, V(n) = 0 for n < 0, the contragredient V′ is equivalent to V as a V-module, and V is C2-cofinite. For a finite group G of automorphisms of V, do the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.3. LetV be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the two condi- tions in Conjecture 5.1 and let G be a ﬁnite group of automorphisms of V . Then the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among theg-twistedV -modules for all g∈G satisfy the associativity, commutativity and modular invariance properties.

Conjecture 5.1. Assume that V is a simple vertex operator algebra satisfying the following conditions: (1) V(0) = C1, V(n) = 0 for n< 0 and the contragredient V′, as a V -module, is equivalent to V . (2) V is C2-coﬁnite, that is, dimV/C 2(V )<∞, where C2(V ) is the subspace of V spanned by the elements of the form Resxx−2Y (u,x )v for u,v ∈ V and Y :V⊗V →V [[x,x−1]] is the vertex operator map for V . Then the braided tensor category given in [H8] based on the work [HLZ1]-[HLZ9] is rigid.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = \bigoplus_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} V_{(n)}$ be a simple vertex operator algebra satisfying:
(1) $V_{(0)} = \mathbb{C}\mathbf{1}$, $V_{(n)} = 0$ for $n < 0$, and the contragredient module $V'$ is isomorphic to $V$ as a $V$-module;
(2) $V$ is $C_2$-cofinite, i.e. $\dim V/C_2(V) < \infty$, where $C_2(V)$ is the subspace spanned by elements $\mathrm{Res}_x x^{-2} Y(u,x) v$ for $u, v \in V$ and $Y : V \otimes V \to V[[x, x^{-1}]]$ is the vertex operator of $V$.

Let $G$ be a finite group of automorphisms of $V$, and for each $g \in G$ let the category of $g$-twisted (generalized) $V$-modules be considered. Twisted logarithmic intertwining operators of type $\binom{W_3}{W_1\,W_2}$ among $g$-twisted $V$-modules ($g \in G$) are formal series involving complex powers of the formal variable and finitely many nonnegative integer powers of its logarithm, satisfying the appropriate $g$-twisted Jacobi-type identity and equivariance conditions.

Prove or disprove: products and iterates of such twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among $g$-twisted $V$-modules (over all $g \in G$) converge on suitable domains and satisfy
(a) the associativity property (analytic extension of the iterate equals analytic extension of the product),
(b) the commutativity property (analytic continuation along appropriate paths exchanges products), and
(c) modular invariance for the $q$-traces (and pseudo-$q$-traces) of products of geometrically modified twisted logarithmic intertwining operators on the upper half plane.
artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator algebras and orbifold CFT
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial partial progress exists but the conjecture as a whole has not been fully resolved. Convergence, genus-one associativity, and genus-one commutativity for (untwisted) logarithmic intertwining operators in $C_2$-cofinite VOAs were established by Fiordalisi (2015–2016). Modular invariance for pseudo-$q$-traces of products of geometrically-modified logarithmic intertwining operators in the $C_2$-cofinite case (without negative weights) was proved in work by Huang (arXiv:2305.15152, 2024). For the twisted setting, foundational results on twisted logarithmic intertwining operators and cofiniteness for twisted fusion products have appeared (e.g. arXiv:1702.05845, arXiv:2511.06420, arXiv:2601.12834), but the full associativity-commutativity-modular invariance package for $g$-twisted modules over a finite group $G$ for general $C_2$-cofinite $V$ does not appear to be completely established.

status_evidence.title: Modular invariance of (logarithmic) intertwining operators
status_evidence.snippet: Proves that spaces spanned by analytic extensions of pseudo-q-traces of products of geometrically-modified logarithmic intertwining operators are modular invariant for C_2-cofinite VOAs without negative weights.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves modular invariance in the untwisted logarithmic case, a key ingredient of the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Intertwining operators among twisted modules associated to not-necessarily-commuting automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the theory of twisted intertwining operators for finite groups of automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational framework for twisted intertwining operators in orbifold theory.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness for Twisted Fusion Products in Vertex Operator Algebra Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work establishing cofiniteness properties needed for the twisted orbifold tensor category.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates that ingredients toward the twisted associativity/modular invariance program are still being developed.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness and P(z)-tensor product bifunctors in orbifold theories
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs P(z)-tensor product bifunctors in orbifold theories under cofiniteness assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Continued recent work toward (but not yet completing) the twisted orbifold conjecture.
